343295.「この 封邪の幽谷に 吹くのは\n 太古より エルトナ大陸をおびやかしてきた\n:
The wind that howls through this Corrupted Canyon is an evil gale known as the Magatsukaze, which has threatened Eltona since
time immemorial.

343296.「ある時は 暴風となって すべてを破壊し\n ある時は 毒を振りまき 生命を奪う:
Sometimes it rampages as a violent storm that lays waste to all; at other times, it spews poison that steals the breath of life. All
flesh rots away, and humanity perishes.

343297.「そこで エルドナ神は マガツカゼをはらう\n 対抗策として 清らかな風をつかさ:
Therefore, Eldona created us--the Storm
Kaisers, swordsmen who wield the pure wind--as
a countermeasure to ward off the Magatsukaze.

343298.「すなわち ストームカイザーの使命とは\n マガツカゼを はらい清めること。\n:
In short, Storm Kaiser's quest is to purge and
cleanse Magatsukaze. And in the depths of this
valley...

343299.「おまえは 私の背後へ。\n 何があっても そこから動かぬように。:
Stay behind me. No matter what happens, don't
move from there.

343300.「これなるは マガツカゼの根源……\n その名を マガツタタリカゼ。:
This is the source of the Magatsukaze... its
name is *The Winds of Dread*.

343301.「我が 双刀。\n 悪しき風を 断たんがために。: My twin blades. To cut through the evil winds.

343304.「私は 何度も 奴を封じてきた。\n しかし 時が経つと ふたたび谷底から現れ\:
I've sealed him away time and time again. Yet, as time passes, he rises once more from the depths of the valley and spreads the
Magatsukaze across the entire continent.

343305.「私は この世から マガツカゼを消滅させる。\n すなわち マガツタタリカゼを\:
I will wipe Magatsukaze from the face of the earth. In other words, I do not merely wish to seal away *The Winds of Dread*--I intend to
destroy them completely.

343306.「そのために おまえを 弟子にとる。\n <pc>よ。ストームカイザーとして\n:
That's why I'm taking you on as my apprentice.
I want you to fight alongside me as the Storm
Kaiser.

343307.「……さあ 草庵へ戻ろう。\n まずは 転職の儀を ととのえなければね。:
...All right, let's head back to the
hermitage. First things first, I need to get
the job-change ceremony sorted.

343450.<center>ケ……ケケ ケケケ…………。: Heh... Heh heh. Heh heh heh.
